intelligence.company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.
intelligence.target_audience: Developers and organizations building, testing, and managing APIs.

intelligence.company_overview: Supabase is an open‑source, Postgres‑based developer platform that provides authentication, realtime, storage, RESTful APIs, and edge functions. It is built by developers for developers and is available for self‑hosting or through a managed subscription.
intelligence.target_audience: Developers, startups, and enterprises building SaaS, AI, and web or mobile applications that need scalable backend infrastructure.

intelligence.company_overview: Vapi offers an enterprise‑grade platform that lets developers build, deploy, and manage voice agents at scale. It provides orchestration, real‑time monitoring, and compliance features for Fortune 100 and other organizations.
intelligence.target_audience: Small to large enterprises and organizations that need scalable, compliant voice agent solutions for customer support and interaction.
